title: Formal Certification of the Nevo-Peeva Gap-Free Regularity Theorem and Hall Filtration Homology
abstract: We present a machine-checked formal verification and zero-float exact rational certificate suite (NEVO-PEEVA-CERT-1.0) auditing Luis Alfredo Dupont Garcia's proof of the Nevo-Peeva conjecture for powers of edge ideals of gap-free graphs (arXiv:2611.33501v1). Our artifact combines an 18-theorem constructive Lean 4.35.0 kernel (0 sorry, 0 custom axioms, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings), an AST-audited zero-float Python verifier computing exact rational reduced simplicial homology over Q, 16 canonical JSON certificates (C01-C16), and 37 unit and forgery-rejection tests. We formally verify the arithmetic recurrence and linear-resolution stabilization law reg I(G)^q = max(2q, reg I(G) + q - 1), the Alilooee-Banerjee-Beyarslan-Ha-Jayanthan-Selvaraja (ABBHJS) upper-bound consequence, the complete 64-case vertex-level sign inequality underlying Lemma 2's Hall-defect submodularity, Lemma 3 internalization, residual-mass parity invariance of epsilon(A, c), Proposition 13's independent degree-complex identity Delta_a(I(G)^q) = Gamma_{2q-1-A}(G, a), exact Hochster regularity reg_Q I(G) over all induced subgraphs, and an independent Takayama-formula witness on the 12-vertex complement of the icosahedron proving reg I^2 >= 5 > 4.
